name: QNFO

brand.tagline: A research programme run as an autonomous system on Ultrastable, the foundation for any autonomous system.

idea: An autonomous research programme: the existing fleet, adopted onto the foundation without a rewrite.
goals: Adopt the foundation kernel beside the running fleet
Record the fleet inventory as the first verified evidence
Route research funding through the shared funding loop
positioning: QNFO is the proof case: an existing autonomous research fleet that adopts the foundation.
